create_descriptor_pool: create a new DescriptorPool instance for managing protobuf file descriptors and symbol lookups
add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorPool using the Add method for dynamic registration
add_serialized_file: add a serialized protobuf file to the DescriptorPool using AddSerializedFile from raw bytes
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name using FindMessageTypeByName
find_file_by_name: find a file descriptor by its proto file path using FindFileByName on the pool
